title: Study on the intensity-dependent psychophysiological strain of currently recommended, energy-equivalent exercise dosages in physically inactive individuals with central obesity and metabolic syndrome or type 2 diabetes mellitus (Medi-Run Study 2.0)
summary: Ziel unserer Studie ist es, zu untersuchen, ob es individuelle Unterschiede in der Wahrnehmung unterschiedlicher Trainingsintensitäten bei gleichem Energieverbrauch bei körperlich inaktiven Personen mit zentraler Adipositas und metabolischen Syndrom oder Diabetes mellitus Typ2 gibt. Die aktuellen Trainingsempfehlungen der WHO gelten allgemein für alle Personen mit Bewegungsmangel, und unterscheiden nicht zwischen normal- und übergewichtigen Personen bzw. Personen mit metabolischen Syndrom oder Diabetes mellitus Typ2. Mit den Ergebnissen der Studie können zukünftig individuellere Empfehlungen herausgegeben werden, wodurch die Motivation Sport zu treiben gesteigert werden und die Adhärenz an Bewegungsempfehlungen erhöht werden soll.
conditions: Physical inactivity in individuals with central obesity and metabolic syndrome or type 2 diabetes mellitus

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Men and women between the ages of 30 and 60 and physical inactivity as well as without or with central obesity and MetS or DM-2.
Training status: within the last six months no targeted endurance or strength training or training-effective physical activities (such as ball sports), no history of competitive sports. As a criterion for central, truncal obesity and further diagnostic criteria of a metabolic syndrome (3 out of 5 criteria result in the diagnosis), the specifications of the International Diabetes Federation are used (IDF, 2005):62
1. Waist circumference of ≥ 80 cm (♀) or ≥ 94 cm (♂),
2. Elevated triglycerides ≥ 150 mg/dl or medical treatment,
3. Reduced HDL cholesterol < 40 mg/dl (♀), < 50 mg/dl (♂),
4. Elevated blood pressure systolic ≥ 130 mmHg and/or diastolic ≥ 85 mmHg or medical treatment,
5. Elevated fasting plasma glucose value ≥ 100 mg/dl or medical treatment.
Exclusion criteria:
Individuals with internal medical or orthopedic conditions for which maximal exertion or running training is contraindicated are excluded. Female and male individuals with a relative maximal oxygen uptake of ≥ 45 or 50 ml/min/kg, respectively, are excluded, as they are considered trained. Further exclusion criteria include anemia requiring treatment, a resting blood pressure of ≥ 160/100 mmHg, uncontrolled hyperglycemia, a total cholesterol level of ≥ 300 mg/dl, and a BMI of > 40 kg/m², as intense running training is not recommended for the latter individuals due to orthopedic reasons. Individuals with manifest pre-existing neurological or psychiatric conditions are also excluded from the study, as well as individuals with claustrophobia or mask anxiety. The intake of medications that can directly influence target parameters (e.g., beta-blockers) also leads to exclusion, as does pregnancy.
